name: Admin Back Office
description: Reusable Cloudgate back office with IdP user management, website analytics, editable theme and appearance, SMTP settings, media, workflow logs, About and Wallet payment readiness.

workflowImport.description: Creates the Admin controller, admin_db and protected sample APIs. Appearance and Wallet readiness use native Cloudgate APIs.
workflowImport.publishHint: Import the bundle and schema, publish the three sample actions, and sign in with a tenant IdP Admin account. The server must include the native payments status API and the appearance API with its platform migration.

features: Website analytics and scoped workflow logs
